title.zh: 【Janus Henderson 与 Centrifuge 推出追踪纳斯达克 100 指数的区块链原生基金 JQQQ】
title.en: 【Janus Henderson 与 Centrifuge 推出追踪纳斯达克 100 指数的区块链原生基金 JQQQ】

current_state.zh: Janus Henderson and Centrifuge launched JQQQ, billed as the first Nasdaq-100-licensed tokenized fund, issued on Stellar and initially open to eligible non-US professional investors with a $100,000 minimum investment.

updates.title_en: 【Janus Henderson 与 Centrifuge 推出追踪纳斯达克 100 指数的区块链原生基金 JQQQ】
updates.what_changed_zh:
据《华尔街日报》报道，Janus Henderson 宣布将推出 JQQQ，并称这是首只获得纳斯达克 100 指数授权的代币化基金；该基金采用 Centrifuge 的代币化基础设施，部署在 Stellar 区块链上。基金初期面向美国境外的合格专业投资者开放，最低投资金额为 10 万美元。

此举将 Janus Henderson 的链上产品从美国国债和结构化信贷扩展至股票指数敞口；该资产管理公司称，其机构链上策略规模已超过 10 亿美元。

JQQQ 是设立于英属维尔京群岛的投资公司旗下的独立投资组合，提供对纳斯达克 100 指数的间接敞口，而非持有成分股。该基金依据与纳斯达克签署的授权协议运作。

updates.background_zh: 纳斯达克今年 4 月表示，将把纳斯达克 100 指数的授权范围扩大至更多资产管理公司，包括贝莱德和道富，同时维持与景顺的长期合作——景顺 QQQ 信托 ETF 市值约 4990 亿美元。据 RWA.xyz 数据，Stellar 目前以约 38 亿美元的代币化资产在区块链中排名第四，落后于以太坊、BNB Chain 和 Solana，网络上已有富兰克林邓普顿、Spiko、Ondo 等发行方的代币化资产。存托信托与清算公司（DTCC）今年 5 月宣布将把其代币化服务接入 Stellar，相关代币化资产预计于 2027 年上半年上线。
updates.background_en: Nasdaq said in April it would expand licensing of the Nasdaq-100 Index to additional asset managers including BlackRock and State Street, while maintaining its longstanding partnership with Invesco, whose QQQ Trust ETF has a market cap of about $499 billion. Stellar currently ranks fourth among blockchains by distributed real-world asset value, with roughly $3.8 billion in tokenized assets behind Ethereum, BNB Chain and Solana, according to RWA.xyz, and hosts tokenized assets from issuers including Franklin Templeton, Spiko and Ondo. The Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation said in May it would connect its tokenization service to Stellar, with DTCC-tokenized assets expected in the first half of 2027.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径在于代币化 RWA 基础设施：Stellar 与 Centrifuge 由此获得一家大型资产管理公司作为发行方，可能为该链带来更多机构发行。但目前覆盖面有限——基金仅面向非美国专业投资者、门槛为 10 万美元——而 XLM 周二在 0.17 美元附近交易，年内下跌约 16%，显示链上 RWA 规模的增长尚未传导至该网络代币。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through tokenized RWA infrastructure: Stellar and Centrifuge gain a major asset manager as an issuer, which could draw further institutional issuance to that chain. The reach is narrow for now — the fund is limited to non-US professional investors with a $100,000 minimum — and XLM traded near $0.17 on Tuesday, down about 16% year to date, indicating that growth in onchain RWA value has not carried over into the network token.
